tokens.name: umber
tokens.usage: Base dark ground: films, testimonial, footer. Ivory text 17:1.

tokens.name: bark
tokens.usage: Raised dark ground: offerings. Ivory text 14:1.

tokens.name: clay
tokens.usage: Light ground: manifesto, story. Warm, never flat grey.

tokens.name: clay-deep
tokens.usage: Deeper light ground: letters sign-up. Ink text 11:1.

tokens.name: ivory
tokens.usage: Text and logo on umber, bark and film (on scrim). Fill of the hero's main button.

tokens.name: ivory-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text on umber, bark and film (about 9:1 on umber).

tokens.name: ivory-faint
tokens.usage: Tertiary marks on dark: rail numbers, '/ 05', footer base. Not for sentences.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text and logo on clay; text on ivory buttons.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text on clay (5.7:1).

tokens.name: forest
tokens.usage: THE brand accent. Fill of primary buttons with ivory text (5.5:1). One accent per screen.

tokens.name: forest-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover.

tokens.name: forest-deep
tokens.usage: Accent text on clay: manifesto accent words (italic), signature (5.7:1).

tokens.name: forest-light
tokens.usage: Accent text and marks on umber and film: testimonial quote mark.

tokens.name: earth
tokens.usage: Chapter accent, Earth. Only on the chapter number and the title's full stop.

tokens.name: water
tokens.usage: Chapter accent, Water. Only on the chapter number and the title's full stop.

tokens.name: fire
tokens.usage: Chapter accent, Fire. Only on the chapter number and the title's full stop. Never a button or strip.

tokens.name: air
tokens.usage: Chapter accent, Air. Only on the chapter number and the title's full stop.

tokens.name: ether
tokens.usage: Chapter accent, Ether. Only on the chapter number and the title's full stop.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Cormorant Garamond Light: lean, classical, the face of the OM mark. Very large, never bold.

styles.name: chapter
styles.usage: One element word per chapter, with an accent full stop. clamp(78px, 15vw, 280px).

styles.name: manifesto
styles.usage: Written in letter by letter. Accent words in Light Italic, forest-deep. clamp(38px, 6.1vw, 112px).

styles.name: quote
styles.sample: I left believing in myself again.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: My work as a coach is deeply rooted
styles.usage: Story lead, spec values (20-28px). Mid sizes use 400 so hairlines hold.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Instrument Sans for everything small: body, labels, buttons.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Body. 16px on phones. Max 40ch on film, 56ch on clay.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Icon and label gaps.

tokens.name: space-s
tokens.usage: Tile gap, copy stack on phones.

tokens.name: space-m
tokens.usage: Spec columns, copy stacks.

tokens.name: space-l
tokens.usage: Footer columns.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Column gaps on desktop.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Page gutter: clamp(18px, 4vw, 64px). Copy always starts on it, aligned with the logo.

tokens.name: base
tokens.usage: Copy distance from the bottom of a slide: clamp(30px, 6.5vh, 72px). The same on every slide.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Films and full-screen slides.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: Photo tiles and the framed story photo.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons and round icon buttons.

tokens.name: slide-height
tokens.usage: Every slide is one screen (min 540px). The page snaps to each one.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Header (64px on phones). Transparent; ink follows the slide beneath.
